title: VodafoneThree to test Nokia's AI-RAN with Nvidia GPUs

title: Opinion: Nokia's Hotard: AI is about to escape the data center
content: In an exclusive interview in Finland, Nokia CEO Justin Hotard explains why the next wave of AI growth will extend far beyond the data center — and why intelligent networks, new carrier business models and national sovereignty are central to Nokia's future.

title: Why AI Needs More Than Centralized Data Centers

title: MU: TomorrowX Summit
content: AI-driven demand remains robust, with 75% of 2027 output sold and 2027–2028 supply expected to be tighter than 2026. Multi-year SCAs and planned 2028–2029 stacked DRAM launches underpin visibility and growth.
